name: Custodis
tagline: The health record your dog would keep if it had thumbs.
positioning: Custodis turns collar sensors, vet visits, and daily walks into one clear timeline for the people who take pet care seriously.

hero.h1: One record. Every vet, walk, and weigh-in.
hero.sub: Custodis pulls your pet's collar data, clinic paperwork, and daily routine into a single timeline you actually trust — so nothing about their health gets lost between apps.

features.title: One timeline, zero silos
features.description: Vaccinations, weight logs, activity, and meds land on a single scrollable timeline instead of six apps and a shoebox of receipts.

features.title: Vet-ready export
features.description: Generate a clean PDF summary before any appointment — last labs, meds, and weight trend, formatted the way clinics expect.

features.title: Trend alerts that matter
features.description: We flag a drift in weight, appetite, or activity before it becomes a 9pm emergency-vet Google search.

features.title: Works with your collar
features.description: Sync steps, sleep, and location from the trackers you already own — no proprietary hardware to buy.

features.title: Reminders you won't ignore
features.description: Flea meds, booster shots, and grooming, scheduled around your pet's actual history, not a generic template.

features.title: Multi-pet households
features.description: Switch between Biscuit, Nero, and the cat in one tap. Each animal keeps its own record and reminders.

testimonials.quote: My senior lab has three specialists. Before Custodis I was texting photos of lab results between clinics. Now I hand over one export and everyone's on the same page.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The weight-trend alert caught a slow decline in my cat months before I would have. My vet was genuinely impressed by the summary I brought in.
testimonials.name: Daniel Ostrowski

testimonials.quote: I run a small boarding setup and every guest arrives with a different app. Custodis exports are the one format I ask owners for now.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: One pet, one timeline, all the basics.
For homes with more than one set of paws.
For fosters, breeders, and small caretakers.

homepage.footerBlurb: Custodis keeps one honest record of your pet's whole life — from first shots to golden years. Built for people who show up for their animals.
